cards.title: CONCEPT
cards.text: Second concept on the pregnancy-shame angle, GLP-1 cohort. One-to-one replica of the Arctic Goddess timeline infographic (FB 1647750243002287, 83 days running, their longest active runner): cream field, condensed navy-over-red two-line headline, three progressively-changed anatomy-chart figures with red annotation circles fading to nothing, time labels beneath, two jars on a cream pedestal, italic grey results disclaimer. Their labels were OCTOBER / NOVEMBER / DECEMBER; ours are DAY 1 / DAY 5 / WEEK 4, taken from the mechanism bible rather than invented. Three headline variations, identical body and art direction. GPT Image 2 quality high, jar as reference image, 9:16 at 1080x1920. TL-02 and TL-03 re-rendered with proper headline margins.

cards.title: REVISION LOG
cards.text:
TL-02 v1: whole body slimmed across the three panels (arms, thighs, hips, bust). That reads as weight loss rather than swelling going down, which is off-mechanism and the exact thing Meta polices in this vertical.
TL-02 v2: body consistency fixed by stating the constraint explicitly, identical bust, shoulders, arms, hips and thighs, abdomen as the only variable.

TL-02 v3 and TL-03 v2 (current): Brooks flagged the headlines running too close to the left and right edges on both. Re-rendered with an explicit margin rule, no letter closer to either edge than one tenth of the image width, type sized down to fit inside it, plus clear space above the first line.

TL-01 was correct on both counts from the first render and has not been touched.

cards.title: WHERE THE TIMELINE COMES FROM
cards.text:
Labels are DAY 1 / DAY 5 / WEEK 4, taken from the mechanism bible:

'First few days quiet (it's not a laxative). First normal, non-cramping movement often around day five. Fills in over a few weeks. Rewards consistency, not a one-bottle test.'

Day 1 = starting state. Day 5 = the bible's first-movement marker. Week 4 = 'fills in over a few weeks.'

FLAGGED: the Week 2 and Week 3 beats in the body copy are extrapolated from 'fills in over a few weeks.' Consistent with the mechanism but not sourced beat by beat. Cut them if you want the copy fully sourced.

cards.title: WHAT WE DID NOT COPY
cards.text:
The reference body copy claims '93% of our women see a massive transformation by the end of this 6-week plan.'

We have no such number. Inventing one breaks Law 2, so it is absent and no substitute stat was invented in its place.

The reference also runs a 6-week protocol with a beat for every week. Ours is four weeks because that is what the mechanism bible supports.

cards.title: SHARED PRIMARY TEXT
cards.text:
If you are on a GLP-1 and your stomach still reads pregnant by the afternoon, this is the part nobody explains.

A GLP-1 works by slowing digestion down. That is the point, and it works. The trouble is the slowdown reaches all the way to your colon.

Your colon is a muscle. It contracts on a signal called butyrate, a short-chain fatty acid the bacteria in your colon make out of the fiber that reaches them. Slow everything down and less reaches them. The colony thins out, butyrate falls, the muscle gets a weaker signal, and less moves the next day. What stays behind ferments, and fermenting stool is what pushes your abdomen out by two in the afternoon.

Motilli rebuilds that from the bottom up. Concentrated celery juice standardized for a real dose of apigenin, which barely absorbs into your bloodstream and so stays down in the colon where the work is, plus a fine soluble fiber that feeds the butyrate makers without the coarse bulk that bloats.

Here is what four weeks actually looks like.

Days 1 to 4: Quiet. Nothing is forced, because this is not a laxative. The apigenin is calming the lining while the fiber feeds what is left of the colony.

Day 5: The first normal, non-cramping movement for most women. It arrives on its own and it does not hurt.

Week 2: It starts happening without you planning around it, and the afternoon distension has somewhere to go now.

Week 3: Less sitting and waiting. Less pressure by evening. The waistband stops being the thing you notice at four o'clock.

Week 4: The colony is rebuilt enough to signal on its own. Regular, and the belly that showed up every afternoon has a lot less to show up with.

None of this touches your weight loss. Weight loss lives in the brain and the appetite, which is the dial the medication turns. This lives in the colon and the bacteria in it. Because they are separate systems, you rebuild the gut and you stay on the medication.

Three gummies before bed with a full glass of water. Third-party tested, lab results posted.

Ninety days to decide. Email inside ninety days and every dollar comes back, no return required. A rebuild takes weeks, so the guarantee has to outlast the timeline.

cards.title: AUDIT
cards.text:
Law 2: no invented study, percentage, doctor, review count or customer quote. Timeline labels trace to the mechanism bible. Weeks 2 and 3 flagged as extrapolated.

Law 9: clean through lawgate, no blockers.

Two separate systems: present, as the bible requires.

Swap test: PASS. The butyrate loop, the apigenin-stays-in-the-colon detail and the rebuild-then-feed order are ours.

Shelf life: evergreen.

RESULTS-CLAIM RISK: 'GONE IN 4 WEEKS' is a harder efficacy promise than anything else we run for Motilli, and a body-progression sequence in a GLP-1-adjacent ad is the highest-scrutiny creative on Meta. The disclaimer is on the image and only the abdomen changes, which is the honest version of the claim. Worth a compliance read before spending.

VERIFY BEFORE LAUNCH: the 90-day no-return-required guarantee wording against the live policy page.
